Standards for bedding supplies in detail
Watching the care lead is the best way to learn it

This page matters because bedding is part of how we keep companion animals settled, clean, and safe while they move through Aurelia Skyways service. On the Companion Animal Travel Desk, you are not just handing over materials; you are checking comfort, hygiene, and fit for the carrier and for the pet inside it. New staff should treat every bedding choice as part of the travel plan, not as an extra.

Start by looking at the passenger's needs, the pet's size, and the type of carrier approved for the trip. Bedding should stay neat, dry, and easy to inspect. If the material is loose, torn, or overly bulky, replace it before the pet is accepted for movement. Keep the surface soft enough to support rest, but firm enough that it does not bunch up or block airflow. When a passenger arrives worried, use plain language and stay calm so they can see that the process is under control.

<<FACT F041>> Check the bedding in the same sweep you use to confirm carrier condition, ID tags, and service notes. If the ground team is moving a carrier between services, make sure the bedding stays in place and does not pick up dirt or moisture. Small details matter here, because a clean bed helps the animal settle and also helps the next team member inspect the setup quickly.

When you prepare a handoff, speak with the passenger coordinator and confirm that the bedding matches the current care plan. If the traveler has brought a familiar cloth or pad, make sure it is safe and allowed before it goes into the carrier. Some pets relax better with a known item, but the item still has to meet desk standards. Keep an eye on the edges, fasteners, and corners, since those are the places that cause trouble first.

<<FACT F051>> If you are uncertain, pause and ask the care lead before you proceed. That habit protects the pet, the passenger, and the rest of the workflow.

Remember: clean bedding, careful checks, and calm handling are the standard every shift.
